scope: One external published-comparator context record for each frozen 24-cell final-answer population, paired with the highest point estimate among the 13 primary reconstruction methods.
supersedes_for_scope: For frozen24 reporting only, this registry replaces legacy paper-to-cell mappings in results/advisor_inscope/competitors_verified.csv and the generic Semantic Entropy/TSV notes in configs/reconstruction_benchmark_v1/comparators.json.

v2_metrics_source.comparison_scope: 13 primary methods on the same v2 cell cohort
v2_metrics_source.leader_semantics: highest point estimate only; not a claim of statistical separation

comparison_policy.direct_v2_methods: The 13 primary v2 methods are direct common-cohort comparisons within each cell.
comparison_policy.published_values: Every published number in this registry is from a different generated population. It may appear only in a separate context card.
comparison_policy.identity_boundary: A local audit proving that a v2 cell matches its stored raw source establishes local provenance only; it does not establish identity with the rows generated in a paper.
comparison_policy.delta_rule: A paper-to-v2 delta is forbidden unless the comparator is rerun on the exact v2 cohort with the same labels, prediction unit, metric, and evaluator and emits row-level scores plus a matching cohort hash.
comparison_policy.legacy_local_aggregates: Legacy aggregate-only files are BLOCKED_PENDING_COMMON_ROW_RERUN; n_rows or n_overlap alone does not prove row identity.

report_contract.direct_panel: Plot only the 13 v2 methods on their identical cell cohort, with AUROC confidence intervals. Call the recorded method the highest point estimate, not the winner, and show the uncertainty-equivalent top set when available.
report_contract.published_context_panel: Render the published method/value in a separate gray context card titled 'Published context — different generated population'. Include paper title, table, model, dataset, supervision, access, passes, and visible match-axis badges.
report_contract.related_context_panel: Use the same separate card with an additional 'related, not the cell's primary anchor' badge.
report_contract.no_comparator_panel: Show 'No eligible published comparator found' explicitly; do not leave an empty chart region.
report_contract.visual_encoding: Use solid project colors for direct v2 results and a hollow gray marker or card for paper context. Never connect the two with a delta line or aligned difference axis.
report_contract.export_rule: Context rows must export delta_eligible=false and a null delta. A future exact/common-row replay must be a new comparator record with row-level predictions, the v2 cohort hash, and matched evaluator metadata.
report_contract.legend_rule: A visible legend must explain direct versus context markers, confidence intervals, better direction, cohort, access, supervision, and pass count; hover text is supplementary only.

match_axis_statuses.EXACT: The audited sources establish that the named axis matches.
match_axis_statuses.PARTIAL: Some protocol details match, but identity is incomplete or an important detail differs.
match_axis_statuses.DIFFERENT: The axis is known to differ.
match_axis_statuses.UNKNOWN: The available primary source does not establish a match.
match_axis_statuses.NOT_APPLICABLE: There is no published comparator for this cell.
